name: combined immunodeficiency due to ORAI1 deficiency
description: A form of combined immunodeficiency due to Calcium release activated Ca2+ (CRAC) channel dysfunction characterized by recurrent infections, congenital myopathy, ectodermal dysplasia and anhydrosis.
